master_script.hook: Salon owners, 12 baje tak reply nahi mila?

hooks.text: Salon owners, 12 baje tak reply nahi mila?
30 seconds mein aapka reel lead generate karega…
Raat 11 baje WhatsApp pe appointment likha, reply dete, salon chala gaya.
Main reel scripts ke baare mein galat tha…
Asli sachchai ye hai… reel scripts ke liye
Ye karna band karo… reel script ka pehla second waste

beats.line: Salon owners, 12 baje tak reply nahi mila?
beats.visual: Phone shows 11pm WhatsApp message, no reply, then empty booking slot

beats.line: Maine 5 local businesses ko WhatsApp par message kiya, aur unmein se 4 ne jawab nahi diya, isliye salon ka jawab abhi nahi aata.
beats.visual: WhatsApp chat showing 5 sent messages, 4 with no answer

beats.line: Par aapka reel script is problem ko kaise solve karega?
beats.visual: Question mark animation appears over a reel thumbnail

beats.line: Pehle sawal likho, line me sawal dikhayo, phir video end me WhatsApp icon daalo.
beats.visual: Notepad shows bullet points: 1. Sawalan likho, 2. Hook me sawal dikhayo, 3. WhatsApp icon daalo

beats.line: Short videos aapke sawaal ka turant jawab dete, aapka time bachaate hain.
beats.visual: Clock ticks down, then shows saved time and happy salon owner

beats.line: Agar aapko yeh reel script chahiye, comment mein bas SCRIPT likhein, aur aapko DM mein ek quick setup plan ya honest advice mil jayegi ki yeh aapke salon ke liye fit hai ya nahi.
beats.visual: Comment box highlighted, word SCRIPT typed
steps: DM mein quick setup plan mil jayega

master_script.cta: Agar aapko yeh reel script chahiye, comment mein bas SCRIPT likhein, aur aapko DM mein ek quick setup plan ya honest advice mil jayegi ki yeh aapke salon ke liye fit hai ya nahi.
